entries.name: Chtholly — front

provenance.prompt: Recovered generation; exact historical prompt unavailable.

limitations: Native recovered atlas requires row-based segmentation and scale normalization; wide sword attacks span four cells across the row.

provenance.prompt: Create a NEW sprite atlas with exactly TWENTY isolated full-body RUNNING POSES in FIVE equally spaced columns and FOUR equally spaced horizontal rows. Every row has FIVE drawings, never4, all5 columns occupied. This atlas is ONLY running animations, no idle/walk/attack/hurt/death/portrait. Match character design and CRISP PIXEL ART rendering from attached references, transparent alpha, no background floor text grid or gradients. 2.5–3 heads tall RPG sprites; complete sword and feet visible in each frame. Each row a complete FIVE-phase coherent RUN LOOP: 1 left foot lands, 2 left leg pushes off with right knee raised, 3 airborne leg-switch, 4 right foot lands, 5 right leg pushes off left knee raised. Never repeat same pose twice. Hair and clothes react; consistent body scale. ROW ONE: Chtholly running TOWARDS camera FRONT, clear frontal face and torso every pose, navy military jacket, dark skirt, ankle boots, clear cerulean long hair with2littlehighbunches, Seniorious silver broad cracked sword dark thorn guard held safely low. ROW TWO: same Chtholly RUNNING AWAY camera BACK, no face or eyes in any frame. ROW THREE: Willem running AWAY camera BACK, messy black hair, navy gold-button military jacket, trousers boots, Percival long narrow silver angular sword held low; no face/eyes visible. ROW FOUR: same Willem running strictly RIGHT in SIDE PROFILE. Five full body drawings in each row. Layout5columns4rows20sprites, landscape canvas1536x1024, ample transparent gaps, no ground shadows.

entries.name: Chtholly — portrait pixel art

provenance.prompt: Create a sprite strip of exactly THREE separate PIXEL ART CHARACTER PORTRAITS, THREE EQUAL square columns in ONE row, RGBA transparent background. Sharp crisp pixel clusters and limited cel palette, NO digital-paint gradients, no halo, text, signature or grid. Eachportrait bust from head to shoulders, face3/4turnedtowardsRIGHT, wholehairheadfits withpadding, shoulders end atbottom. LEFT: Chtholly military act1, samefirstreference clear ceruleanblue longhair2littlehighbunches, oceanblueeyes, navyhighcollar silverbuttons silverbroochwithbluedrop, absolutely no redhair and no armorplate. CENTRE: Willem Kmetsch samesecondreference messydarknearblackhair darkeyes tiredkindadultman navygoldbuttonmilitaryhighcollar, leanface. RIGHT: Ithea samethirdreference ambercateyes straworangehairlongbraidsbluebeads brightredscarf palecreamgreenjacket, mischievousconfidentsmile. Native image landscape1536x512 or1536x1024, three identicalsquareportraitboxes, noframes, nofullbodyposes. MatchPIXELARTapprovedsheetstyle.

limitations: Separate square portrait cutout and nearest-neighbor fit to256x256 required.
